entries.title: Jeremiah 49:1
segments: ¶Against the Ammonites. Thus says the LORD: "Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why [then] does Milcom inherit Gad, And his people dwell in its cities?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:2
segments: Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the LORD, "That I will cause to be heard an alarm of war In Rabbah of the Ammonites; It shall be a desolate mound, And her villages shall be burned with fire. Then Israel shall take possession of his inheritance," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:3
segments: "Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is plundered! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah, Gird yourselves with sackcloth! Lament and run to and fro by the walls; For Milcom shall go into captivity With his priests and his princes together.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:4
segments: Why do you boast in the valleys, Your flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? Who trusted in her treasures, [saying], 'Who will come against me?'

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:5
segments: Behold, I will bring fear upon you," Says the Lord GOD of hosts, "From all those who are around you; You shall be driven out, everyone headlong, And no one will gather those who wander off.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:6
segments: But afterward I will bring back The captives of the people of Ammon," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:7
segments: ¶Against Edom. Thus says the LORD of hosts: "[Is] wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:8
segments: Flee, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan! For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, The time [that] I will punish him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:9
segments: If grape-gatherers came to you, Would they not leave [some] gleaning grapes? If thieves by night, Would they not destroy until they have enough?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:10
segments: But I have made Esau bare; I have uncovered his secret places, And he shall not be able to hide himself. His descendants are plundered, His brethren and his neighbors, And he [is] no more.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:11
segments: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve [them] alive; And let your widows trust in Me."

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:12
segments: For thus says the LORD: "Behold, those whose judgment [was] not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunk. And [are] you the one who will altogether go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink [of it].

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:13
segments: "For I have sworn by Myself," says the LORD, "that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. And all its cities shall be perpetual wastes."

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:14
segments: I have heard a message from the LORD, And an ambassador has been sent to the nations: "Gather together, come against her, And rise up to battle!

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:15
segments: "For indeed, I will make you small among nations, Despised among men.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:16
segments: Your fierceness has deceived you, The pride of your heart, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, Who hold the height of the hill! Though you make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:17
segments: "Edom also shall be an astonishment; Everyone who goes by it will be astonished And will hiss at all its plagues.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:18
segments: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah And their neighbors," says the LORD, "No one shall remain there, Nor shall a son of man dwell in it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:19
segments: "Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the floodplain of the Jordan Against the dwelling place of the strong; But I will suddenly make him run away from her. And who [is] a chosen [man that] I may appoint over her? For who [is] like Me? Who will arraign Me? And who [is] that shepherd Who will withstand Me?"

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:20
segments: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that He has taken against Edom, And His purposes that He has proposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out; Surely He shall make their dwelling places desolate with them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:21
segments: The earth shakes at the noise of their fall; At the cry its noise is heard at the Red Sea.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:22
segments: Behold, He shall come up and fly like the eagle, And spread His wings over Bozrah; The heart of the mighty men of Edom in that day shall be Like the heart of a woman in birth pangs.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:23
segments: ¶Against Damascus. "Hamath and Arpad are shamed, For they have heard bad news. They are fainthearted; [There is] trouble on the sea; It cannot be quiet.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:24
segments: Damascus has grown feeble; She turns to flee, And fear has seized [her]. Anguish and sorrows have taken her like a woman in labor.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:25
segments: Why is the city of praise not deserted, the city of My joy?

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:26
segments: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, And all the men of war shall be cut off in that day," says the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:27
segments: "I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, And it shall consume the palaces of Ben-Hadad."

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:28
segments: ¶Against Kedar and against the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon shall strike. Thus says the LORD: "Arise, go up to Kedar, And devastate the men of the East!

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:29
segments: Their tents and their flocks they shall take away. They shall take for themselves their curtains, All their vessels and their camels; And they shall cry out to them, 'Fear [is] on every side!'

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:30
segments: "Flee, get far away! Dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Hazor!" says the LORD. "For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, And has conceived a plan against you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:31
segments: "Arise, go up to the wealthy nation that dwells securely," says the LORD, "Which has neither gates nor bars, Dwelling alone.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:32
segments: Their camels shall be for booty, And the multitude of their cattle for plunder. I will scatter to all winds those in the farthest corners, And I will bring their calamity from all its sides," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:33
segments: "Hazor shall be a dwelling for jackals, a desolation forever; No one shall reside there, Nor son of man dwell in it."

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:34
segments: ¶The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:35
segments: "Thus says the LORD of hosts: 'Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, The foremost of their might.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:36
segments: Against Elam I will bring the four winds From the four quarters of heaven, And scatter them toward all those winds; There shall be no nations where the outcasts of Elam will not go.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:37
segments: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies And before those who seek their life. I will bring disaster upon them, My fierce anger,' says the LORD; 'And I will send the sword after them Until I have consumed them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:38
segments: I will set My throne in Elam, And will destroy from there the king and the princes,' says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 49:39
segments: 'But it shall come to pass in the latter days: I will bring back the captives of Elam,' says the LORD."
